text: For the simplified Iris dataset (binary, 2 classes, 150 instances), an evolutionary algorithm that searches pruning masks under the strong Lottery Ticket Hypothesis protocol identifies masks that match unpruned performance (100% validation accuracy) for the BVQC with 122 parameters and the SNN with 170 parameters.

For the simplified Iris dataset (binary, 2 classes, 150 instances), an evolutionary algorithm that searches pruning masks without weight training produces large accuracy gains for the MVQC with 184 parameters from approximately 75% to 95% validation accuracy.
